dina: noticed a small cluster of telemetry backfills routed to spot pool during last night's migration; jobs stalled for ~90m. job id rbk-eu-2026-03-22-11. anyone else?

raj: saw alerts. console showed job running but per-pool tokens zero. looks like control-plane reported eu-priority but router picked fallback.

marty: quick grep shows controller shipped a field rename in the rollout: `weight` -> `prio`. router strictly validates and fallbacked.

dina: that would explain the mismatch window. can we patch router to accept the alias?

raj: short-term: restart router-mesh to pick up fixed snapshot. longer-term: parser tolerance + rollout preflight.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-179 created and tagged 9 backfills. Notifying infra-oncall. :bell:

jo: UX note: console should show "control-plane vs data-plane" mismatch and last-applied snapshots. I'll add a small banner in job details.

marty: also propose a CI check that diffs schema keys for any migration PR touching routing. Prevents accidental renames.

dina: agreed. I'll coordinate canary resume once router refresh done.

(20m later)

raj: router-mesh restarted, canary of 30 jobs routed correctly to dedicated-eu. All good.

dina: resuming queued EU backfills at reduced rate. adding postmortem pointer to INC-2026-179.

jo: opened console PR #4982 for mismatch banner.

marty: filing parser-tolerance RFC and preflight gate.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-179 closed. :white_check_mark:

dina: thanks all, closing thread.
